title: GitHub REST API Automation knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement correctly describes GitHub REST API Automation?
options: REST automation sends authenticated HTTP requests, checks response codes, follows pagination, handles rate limits, and processes structured JSON safely.
Give every job write permission to avoid troubleshooting authorization errors.
Print all environment variables and event payloads to make the run easier to debug.
Run untrusted pull-request code in the same job that holds production credentials.
questions.answer_key: REST automation sends authenticated HTTP requests, checks response codes, follows pagination, handles rate limits, and processes structured JSON safely.
questions.explanation: This is the central behavior of github rest api automation: REST automation sends authenticated HTTP requests, checks response codes, follows pagination, handles rate limits, and processes structured JSON safely. Validate configuration and behavior against the current official reference before production use.

questions.prompt: How should a reviewer verify a change related to github rest api automation?
options: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
Assume the workflow is correct as soon as the YAML file is committed.
Retry every failure without looking at the exit code or preserving evidence.
Publish the workflow to production before reviewing its triggers and permissions.
questions.answer_key: Run a controlled test or static check, inspect the relevant job and step result, and compare the evidence with the stated acceptance criteria.
questions.explanation: Reliable verification uses observable evidence.
